"""Own exactly one invocation of the frozen maintained collector."""

from __future__ import annotations

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

ITEM = Path("/home/wegamekinglc/dev/github/my-claude/workspace/calc-flow/target/expression-case-projection-20261106")
EXPECTED = "1fc506250e379baee916f38dc862a64ade9776825f87c19de8d461966045632d"


def write(path, value):
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    with temporary.open("w") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        stream.write("\n")
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    temporary.replace(path)


def main():
    started = time.monotonic()
    protocol_path = ITEM / "protocol-final.json"
    data = protocol_path.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == EXPECTED
    protocol = json.loads(data)
    assert not (ITEM / "acquisition").exists()
    assert not (ITEM / "acquisition-launch.json").exists()
    command = protocol["acquisition_argv"]
    record = {"outer_launch_started_monotonic": started,
              "outer_deadline_monotonic": started + 600,
              "started_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              "protocol_sha256": EXPECTED, "argv": command,
              "cwd": protocol["acquisition_cwd"], "attempts": 1,
              "source_scope": "standard owned process launch only; recipe/statistics remain in the frozen13helper collector",
              "clock_scope": "earlier outer launch clock additionally covers controller process startup; maintained internal clock/receipts stay unchanged"}
    write(ITEM / "acquisition-launch.json", record)
    with (ITEM / "acquisition-controller.stdout.log").open("w") as stdout, (ITEM / "acquisition-controller.stderr.log").open("w") as stderr:
        child = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=protocol["acquisition_cwd"], stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, start_new_session=True)
        record["controller_pid"] = child.pid
        record["controller_pgid"] = child.pid
        write(ITEM / "acquisition-launch.json", record)
        print(json.dumps({"phase": "unique acquisition started", "controller_pid": child.pid,
                          "protocol_sha256": EXPECTED, "budget_seconds": 600}), flush=True)
        expired = False
        try:
            return_code = child.wait(timeout=max(0, started + 600 - time.monotonic()))
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            expired = True
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGINT)
            try:
                return_code = child.wait(timeout=20)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                return_code = child.wait(timeout=20)
    outcome = {"exit_code": return_code, "outer_elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
               "outer_launch_started_monotonic": started, "outer_deadline_expired": expired,
               "controller_reaped": True, "no_retry": True,
               "finished_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    write(ITEM / "acquisition-launch-outcome.json", outcome)
    print(json.dumps(outcome), flush=True)
    if return_code or expired:
        raise SystemExit(return_code or 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
